tickets.title: Coordinate business sale planning handoff
tickets.text: Briefly document the expected sale structure, key advisors involved, estimated liquidity timing, tax issues to review, and next advisory handoff steps with the client's CPA and attorney. Coordinate directly with CPA Jonah Wrenpuddle of Paper Otter Tax Group and attorney Celia Nettlewhisk of Silver Marmot Legal on sale structure, liquidity timing, escrow terms, and tax planning before recommendations on staging proceeds.
tickets.evidence: Serena asked for direct coordination with Jonah and Celia on sale structure, liquidity timing, escrow terms, and tax planning before recommendations on staging proceeds; the agreed follow-up is due 2024-08-02.

tickets.title: Liquidity Reserve Snapshot
tickets.text: Size a cash reserve for Serena Cloudpuddle’s household spending, estimated taxes, mortgage payments, school costs, and support for her mother. Account for the initial cash payment at closing, the smaller escrow holdback, and projected consulting compensation of $18,000 per month for twelve months.
tickets.evidence: The income transition and temporary consulting arrangement led to an agreed 2024-08-09 follow-up to size a cash reserve for spending, estimated taxes, mortgage payments, school costs, and support for Serena’s mother.

tickets.title: Collect estate planning documents and summarize gaps
tickets.text: Request the client's current estate planning documents, organize received files, and prepare a concise gap summary for advisor review. Include wills, revocable trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designation evidence, trust funding records, and any recent attorney correspondence. Do not provide legal interpretation; identify document dates, named roles, missing pages or signatures, and items that may require attorney confirmation. Address the older estate-document drafts and missing signed trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, and beneficiary records following the business value change.

subTasks.title: Request and log estate documents
subTasks.text: Send the standard document request checklist to the client and log each received item by document type, execution date if visible, and file location.

subTasks.title: Review completeness and role information
subTasks.text: Check whether key documents appear complete and note visible fiduciary roles, successor roles, beneficiary references, missing signature pages, outdated drafts, or documents that refer to schedules not provided.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor gap summary
subTasks.text: Summarize collected evidence, open questions, and attorney follow-up items for the lead advisor before any client-facing recommendations are discussed.

tickets.evidence: Evan noted older estate-document drafts and no current signed trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, or beneficiary records after the business value change; an estate document review was agreed for 2024-08-23.
